variables.name: useCount
variables.comment: a transaction gets freed from the message channel.

variables.name: messageProcessor
variables.comment: * Message processor to whom I belong (if set).

methods.name: protected void uncache()
methods.comment: * Hook method, overridden by subclasses

methods.name: public abstract void close()
methods.comment: * Close the message channel.

methods.name: public abstract SIPTransactionStack getSIPStack()
methods.comment:
* Get the SIPStack object from this message channel.
     * 
     * @return SIPStack object of this message channel

methods.name: public abstract String getTransport()
methods.comment:
* Get transport string of this message channel.
     * 
     * @return Transport string of this message channel.

methods.name: public abstract boolean isReliable()
methods.comment:
* Get whether this channel is reliable or not.
     * 
     * @return True if reliable, false if not.

methods.name: public abstract boolean isSecure()
methods.comment: * Return true if this is a secure channel.

methods.name: public abstract void sendMessage(SIPMessage sipMessage) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Send the message (after it has been formatted)
     * 
     * @param sipMessage Message to send.

methods.name: public abstract String getPeerAddress()
methods.comment:
* Get the peer address of the machine that sent us this message.
     * 
     * @return a string contianing the ip address or host name of the sender of the message.

methods.name: public abstract int getPeerPort()
methods.comment: * Get the sender port ( the port of the other end that sent me the message).

methods.name: public abstract String getKey()
methods.comment:
* Generate a key which identifies the message channel. This allows us to cache the message
     * channel.

methods.name: public abstract String getViaHost()
methods.comment: * Get the host to assign for an outgoing Request via header.

methods.name: public abstract int getViaPort()
methods.comment: * Get the port to assign for the via header of an outgoing message.

methods.name: protected abstract void sendMessage(byte[] message, InetAddress receiverAddress, int receiverPort, boolean reconnectFlag) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Send the message (after it has been formatted), to a specified address and a specified port
     * 
     * @param message Message to send.
     * @param receiverAddress Address of the receiver.
     * @param receiverPort Port of the receiver.

methods.name: public String getHost()
methods.comment:
* Get the host of this message channel.
     * 
     * @return host of this messsage channel.

methods.name: public int getPort()
methods.comment:
* Get port of this message channel.
     * 
     * @return Port of this message channel.

methods.name: public void sendMessage(SIPMessage sipMessage, Hop hop) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Send a formatted message to the specified target.
     * 
     * @param sipMessage Message to send.
     * @param hop hop to send it to.
     * @throws IOException If there is an error sending the message

methods.name: public void sendMessage(SIPMessage sipMessage, InetAddress receiverAddress, int receiverPort) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Send a message given SIP message.
     * 
     * @param sipMessage is the messge to send.
     * @param receiverAddress is the address to which we want to send
     * @param receiverPort is the port to which we want to send

methods.name: public String getRawIpSourceAddress()
methods.comment: * Convenience function to get the raw IP source address of a SIP message as a String.

methods.name: public static String getKey(InetAddress inetAddr, int port, String transport)
methods.comment: * generate a key given the inet address port and transport.

methods.name: public static String getKey(HostPort hostPort, String transport)
methods.comment: * Generate a key given host and port.

methods.name: public HostPort getHostPort()
methods.comment: * Get the hostport structure of this message channel.

methods.name: public HostPort getPeerHostPort()
methods.comment:
* Get the peer host and port.
     * 
     * @return a HostPort structure for the peer.

methods.name: public Via getViaHeader()
methods.comment:
* Get the Via header for this transport. Note that this does not set a branch identifier.
     * 
     * @return a via header for outgoing messages sent from this channel.

methods.name: public HostPort getViaHostPort()
methods.comment:
* Get the via header host:port structure. This is extracted from the topmost via header of
     * the request.
     * 
     * @return a host:port structure

methods.name: protected void logMessage(SIPMessage sipMessage, InetAddress address, int port, long time)
methods.comment:
* Log a message sent to an address and port via the default interface.
     * 
     * @param sipMessage is the message to log.
     * @param address is the inet address to which the message is sent.
     * @param port is the port to which the message is directed.

methods.name: public void logResponse(SIPResponse sipResponse, long receptionTime, String status)
methods.comment:
* Log a response received at this message channel. This is used for processing incoming
     * responses to a client transaction.
     * 
     * @param receptionTime is the time at which the response was received.
     * @param status is the processing status of the message.
     *

methods.name: protected final String createBadReqRes(String badReq, ParseException pe)
methods.comment:
* Creates a response to a bad request (ie one that causes a ParseException)
     * 
     * @param badReq
     * @return message bytes, null if unable to formulate response

methods.name: private static final boolean copyHeader(String name, String fromReq, StringBuffer buf)
methods.comment:
* Copies a header from a request
     * 
     * @param name
     * @param fromReq
     * @param buf
     * @return
     * 
     * Note: some limitations here: does not work for short forms of headers, or continuations;
     * problems when header names appear in other parts of the request

methods.name: private static final boolean copyViaHeaders(String fromReq, StringBuffer buf)
methods.comment:
* Copies all via headers from a request
     * 
     * @param fromReq
     * @param buf
     * @return
     * 
     * Note: some limitations here: does not work for short forms of headers, or continuations

methods.name: public MessageProcessor getMessageProcessor()
methods.comment: * Get the message processor.
